# RESULT_IMAG1B: the Imagination Audit with a refit permutation reference and a working real-vs-real control (generated by report_imag1b.py from RESULT_IMAG1B.json)
Card `../PREREG_V8F_IMAG1B.md` prefix 4,634 bytes sha256 `40500d68d344`; IMPL_CHOICES_IMAG1B.md sha256 `e12e5a907a7c`. **Tier T0** (a world-model diagnostic, never a driving claim). Models M2b s0 and s1, no model training; probes ridge (lambda 10) and a 2-layer MLP (64, 3 probe seeds). STRATEGIC: **PAUSED (PI item 25)**, not read.
Estimators: interval = episode-cluster bootstrap (B 2,000, seed 0, the same episodes for every row; paired for every difference). A row is **separated** on the claimed side when BOTH its bootstrap 95 % interval excludes the null on that side AND its point lies beyond the 97.5th (or below the 2.5th) percentile of the distribution of that same statistic over R = 199 refit-under-permutation draws (labels deranged across episodes inside the fit fold, probe refitted, the whole statistic recomputed). The paired sign-flip reference is not used.
